title: Solutions Architect - Core FSI
desc:

 As a Solutions Architect, you will shape the future of the Data & AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated data engineering and data science teams in the world. You will be a technical advisor internally to the sales team, and work with the product team as an advocate of your customers in the field. You will help our customers to achieve tangible data-driven outcomes through the use of our Databricks Lakehouse Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise Ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in big data, analytics, data engineering and data science problems
 Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic prospects and customers, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
 This is a Hybrid role, based in Mumbai. 
 The impact you will have: 
 You will partner with the sales team and provide technical leadership to help customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems.
 You will work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks. 
 Consult on Big Data architectures, implement proof of concepts for strategic projects, spanning data engineering, data science and machine learning, and SQL analysis workflows. As well as validating integrations with cloud services, home grown tools, and other 3rd party applications
 Collaborate with your fellow Solutions Architects, using your skills to support each other and our users
 Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks inspired open-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow) across the developer community.
 What we look for: 
 8+ years in a data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or similar pre-sales/consulting role
 8+ years of experience with Big Data technologies, including Apache Spark™, AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Hadoop, Cassandra, and others
 Strong consulting / customer facing experience , working with external clients across a variety of industry markets
 Coding experience in Python, R, Java, Apache Spark™ or Scala
 Experience building distributed data systems
 Have built solutions with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
 Available to travel to customers in your region
 Nice to have: Databricks Certification
 About Databricks 
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering
desc:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
 We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
 Role 
 We are looking for a Sr. Manager of Software Engineering to join our team. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department. The Sr. Manager will oversee Identity and Access control infrastructure while leading a dynamic team advancing Zero Trust technology and flagship cloud security products. In this role, you will manage end-to-end development and quality, collaborating globally with architects, product managers, developers, and engineers to ensure successful production delivery.
 What you’ll do (Role Expectations) 
 Promote the product vision internally and externally as the representative of the company, product, and team at all levels
 Collaborate with product management to develop roadmaps, identify gaps, and implement changes for improved outcomes
 Design solutions and implement with cloud reliability, availability, scalability, and security in mind
 Work with teams and experts to ensure project requirements are met and delivered efficiently
 Contribute to budget planning by assessing resource needs, hardware requirements, metrics, and costs for cloud services
 Who You Are (Success Profile) 
 You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
 You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
 You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
 You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
 You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.
 What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) 
 Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience in software development, enterprise services, networking, and security across large organizations or startups
 Experience building control plane systems on globally distributed databases and skilled in authentication and authorization mechanisms like SAML, OAuth, LDAP, and SCIM
 Skilled in integrating software systems using distributed message queues like RabbitMQ/Kafka and distributed caches like Redis/Memcached
 Proficient in distributed systems, data replication protocols like Paxos variants, and enterprise databases like DynamoDB, Cassandra, or Google Spanner
 What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) 
 Experience leveraging AI/ML models to automate identity threat detection, optimize access management policies, or enhance cloud security operations
 Skilled in using Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized applications and managing microservices architecture

title: Infrastructure Engineer
desc:
About the team
Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.
The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails.
About the role
You keep the infrastructure behind Sarvam’s products running. You handle day-to-day operations — deployments, provisioning, access, incidents and cost questions — and you are expected to automate that work away.
We hire for one instinct above everything else: you notice something done by hand every day, ask why it can’t run itself, and build the thing that removes it — a script, a pipeline step, a bot, a small Kubernetes operator, or an AI agent that does the work. Operations is a large part of this role, and it is where you find what is worth automating.
As you automate your own toil away, more of your time goes into platform and automation work.
Products you may work on
Sarvam builds across a broad range of AI products: voice agents, coding agents, coworker agents, dubbing, our API platform, and the real-time voice and WebRTC infrastructure underneath them, among many others. You will work on the infrastructure behind them.
Responsibilities
• Own infrastructure operations across Sarvam’s products: deployments, provisioning requests, access, environment issues, cost questions
• Respond to incidents, write the runbook or postmortem afterwards, and fix the cause
• Automate repeated work: turn manual steps into pipeline jobs, Terraform modules, templates or self-service for product teams
• Build AI-assisted automations: agents that triage alerts, summarise incidents, review routine changes or answer product teams’ infrastructure questions, with a human approving anything risky
• Security basics: keep images and dependencies patched, rotate credentials, keep secrets out of code, fix security findings
• Reliability basics: keep dashboards and alerts accurate, track SLOs and cost, delete noisy alerts
• Take part in on-call
Requirements
• 2–5 years in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or backend engineering
• Has built infrastructure outside a ticket: a homelab, an open-source contribution, a side project, or an internal tool nobody asked for — and can show the code (GitHub, a blog post or a demo)
• Comfortable on the Linux command line: processes, networking basics, logs, systemd
• Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; has deployed and debugged something running on a cluster
• Scripting in Python, Go or Bash
• Basic Git and CI/CD experience
• Has spotted a repeated manual task — a daily review, a recurring fix, a routine request — and built something that removed it: a script, a CI job, a bot or a Kubernetes operator. You can walk us through what you noticed, why it mattered, what you built and what it saved
• Has used LLMs or AI agents to automate real work, not only for writing code
• Fixes causes rather than the same symptom twice; asks “why is this manual?” before doing it again
• Curious, takes ownership, wants to grow into platform engineering
• Nice to have: Terraform, a public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), Prometheus / Grafana, exposure to SIP, WebRTC or real-time media, any cloud or Kubernetes certification

title: Level 3 SOC Analyst
desc:
About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .
 L3 SOC Analyst 
 Role Overview The L3 SOC Analyst is the senior technical escalation point within the Security Operations Centre (SOC). This role is responsible for leading complex cyber investigations, directing incident response activities, providing threat intelligence expertise, mentoring L1/L2 analysts, and driving continuous improvement of detection and response capabilities. The role combines advanced technical investigation, threat hunting, cyber threat intelligence, incident command, and operational leadership.
 Key Responsibilities ·        Act as the primary technical escalation point for high-severity and complex cyber incidents.
 ·        Lead investigations involving ransomware, business email compromise, insider threats, cloud compromise, identity attacks, and advanced persistent threats.
 ·        Perform detailed scoping, root-cause analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery activities during active incidents.
 ·        Provide incident command support and coordinate response activities across Cybersecurity, IT, Legal, HR, Privacy, and business stakeholders.
 ·        Conduct proactive threat hunting using intelligence, behavioural analytics, SIEM, EDR, NDR, identity, and cloud telemetry.
 ·        Collect, analyse, operationalise, and disseminate cyber threat intelligence from internal and external sources.
 ·        Track threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and map activity to MITRE ATT&CK.
 ·        Develop, tune, and improve detection use cases, correlation rules, analytics, and automated response workflows.
 ·        Own and maintain SOC playbooks, incident response procedures, escalation criteria, and communication templates.
 ·        Provide coaching, mentorship, and quality oversight for L1 and L2 analysts.
 ·        Review alert triage quality, escalation decisions, documentation standards, and investigation outcomes.
 ·        Produce executive-ready incident summaries, threat assessments, lessons learned, and risk-based recommendations.
 ·        Drive continuous improvement activities including post-incident reviews, threat modelling, detection coverage reviews, and operational readiness exercises.
 ·        Support compliance, audit, and regulatory activities including NIST CSF, CMMC, TISAX, and incident response evidence requirements.
 ·        Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.
 Required Qualifications ·        5+ years of experience in SOC Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Digital Forensics, Detection Engineering, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
 ·        Advanced understanding of cyber attack methodologies, adversary behaviour, and incident response frameworks.
 ·        Strong experience with SIEM, EDR, NDR, email security, identity security, and cloud security platforms.
 ·        Experience leading complex investigations and coordinating response activities across multiple teams.
 ·        Strong analytical, investigative, and decision-making skills.
 ·        Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with both technical and executive audiences.
 ·        Ability to operate independently in high-pressure situations and make risk-based decisions.
 Preferred Qualifications ·        GCIH, GCIA, GCTI, CISSP, GCFA, GREM, CEH or equivalent certifications.
 ·        Experience with Microsoft Defender, WIZ, SIEM/SOAR platforms, and cloud-native security tools.
 ·        Experience within a global enterprise SOC or regulated environment.
 ·        Experience leveraging AI, generative AI, and agentic security capabilities to enhance threat detection, investigation, response, and SOC operational efficiency.
 ·        Scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, or similar languages.
 For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export  licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.  As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

title: Application Engineer

 MongoDB PS exists to support the development of our customers’ vision, accelerate customers’ time to value, and drive a multitude of customer adoption scenarios – from building new solutions to modernizing legacy applications or migrating to cloud.  Work as a software developer in a small Agile team delivering solutions onsite for customers focussed on migrating our customers’ legacy relational-based Java applications to a more modern cloud-based architecture running on MongoDB, leveraging the latest GenAI tools and approaches to accelerate this process. title: Principal Engineer
desc:
About the role 
 Rubrik is the Security and AI Operations Company. As we move from protecting data to securing and accelerating our customers' AI transformation, we are rethinking how the whole company works and fully embracing AI in everything we do. 
 The Principal Engineer is a strategic, hands-on role at the same level as an Engineering Director. You will define and execute the technical strategy for Rubrik's AI software factory, the platform on which agents and people take an idea all the way to customer value. 
 To get there, we are moving from an AI-assisted Software Development Lifecycle to an AI Product Development Lifecycle (AI-PDLC), which covers every stage, not just code. Agents do the synthesis, drafting and execution, while people provide judgment and give accountable approval at every key decision. The platform is at an early stage, and you will lead the build of the shared foundation that every function at Rubrik, from Product, Design and Engineering to Sales and Marketing, will use it for its AI workflows. 
 Your primary focus is problem seeking: finding where AI can make the biggest difference, from building products to serving customers, and making the case to fund it. 
 What you'll do 
 Platform strategy 
 Define the technical vision for the AI-PDLC platform: orchestration, approval gates, model and tool gateways, agent runtimes, context, evals and cost visibility. 
 Make the platform usable by every function through clear contracts, paved paths and self-serve tooling. 
 Decide what Rubrik should own, build on and borrow. 
 Turn business opportunities and productivity gaps across Product, Design, Engineering, Support and go-to-market teams into multi-quarter roadmaps. 
 Technical leadership and standards 
 Set the standards for trustworthy agentic workflows: a person approves every agent output, and no workflow skips its quality or security checkpoints. 
 Champion eval-driven development, managed agent identities with native access control, and outcome metrics such as landed rate, revert rate and cost per landed change. 
 Own cross-cutting initiatives (up to about 18 engineers' effort) end to end. Stay hands-on: prototype, write code and review critical changes. 
 Influence and growth 
 Build consensus across Engineering, Product, Design, Support, Security and business functions. 
 Lead the organizational change that AI-native work requires, where ownership means accountability rather than gatekeeping. 
 Coach Engineers toward Principal-level impact, raise the hiring bar, and represent Rubrik externally. 
 About you 
 Typically 15+ years in software engineering, with a significant focus on developer or internal platforms. 
 Proven at Director-level scope, driving technical strategy across multiple complex systems and organizations. 
 Hands-on experience running LLMs and agents in production, including orchestration, tool integration (for example, MCP), context engineering, evals and guardrails. 
 Deep expertise in a general-purpose language (for example, Go, Java, C/C++, Scala or Python) and strong first-principles thinking. 
 Experience scaling secure, highly available platforms, including identity, access control and cost governance. 
 Data-driven: defines outcome metrics and uses them to steer investment and prove impact. 
 A consensus builder and coach who communicates clearly with executives, non-technical stakeholders and global teams. 
 Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation 
 Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

title: Data Scientist III (Team- Valmo)
desc:
About us
Meesho - Every story here begins with a spark of ambition and a touch of entrepreneurial magic. We're not just a platform — we're your partner in transforming dreams into reality.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone - Meesho started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable small businesses to succeed online. We provide sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping costs, growing their business by tapping the company's massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics at cost through third-party logistics providers and our in-house logistics arm Valmo, in an 'Everyday Low Cost' channel for sellers.
Affordable, relatable merchandise mirroring local markets has helped us make inroads with first-time internet users in the country. We cater to an underserved and unique customer base and cover every serviceable pincode in the country. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have enabled us to become the first Indian horizontal e-commerce company.
Know more about Meesho here: https://www.meesho.io/
About Valmo and the Data Science Team
Valmo is Meesho's own logistics arm, built to give sellers and customers cutting-edge, low-cost logistics and supply chain support. Supply Chain Network Optimization sits at the heart of the Valmo Data Science team: we design and plan the network that moves Valmo's shipments every day, from first-mile pickup through sort centres and line haul to last-mile delivery. We use OR, MILP, stochastic optimisation, simulation, ML and DL across network design, first/middle/last-mile optimisation, capacity planning and delivery promise, and we build for the long term, not just today's problems. This role is for someone ready to execute at speed, with a growth mindset, to build and scale these models.
 About the Role
As a Data Scientist 3(Operations Research), you will own a workstream within Valmo network design — not just a model. You will be accountable for the North Star Metric of that workstream (cost per shipment, end-to-end shipment speed, network capacity utilisation, on-time delivery, delivery promise), set its OR/ML roadmap, and mentor DS1s and DS2s in delivering it. You will take ambiguous, loosely-defined business problems, decide which ones are worth solving, formulate them mathematically, and ship optimization systems that run Valmo's network every day. Workstreams span network design, routing and scheduling across the first, middle and last mile.

title: Lead Design Evaluation Engineer
desc:
About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .
 Staff Design   Evaluation   Engineer   –   Automotive   Networking   
 Role Overview   
 Analog Devices   International   is seeking   an experienced   Staff   Design Evaluation   Engineer to join   the   Automotive   Networking   team in   Hyderabad ,   India .   In this senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions.   
 You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices.   
 Key Responsibilities   
 Define and lead comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs.   
 Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation.   
 Architect, develop, bring up, and maintain hardware and software evaluation platforms, test fixtures, reference systems, and supporting infrastructure.   
 Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation.   
 Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries.   
 Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment.   
 Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution.   
 Evaluate   A utomotive Ethernet   T1S   and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability.   
 Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation.   
 Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders.   
 Drive continuous improvement in test architecture, automation, data quality, traceability, repeatability, and laboratory efficiency.   
 Provide technical leadership and mentoring, lead design and code reviews, and contribute to planning, estimation, and prioritisation activities.   
 Required Qualifications and Experience   
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.   
 Typically seven or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role.   
 Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs.

title: Agent Engineer
desc:
The distance between an AI system that works and one that millions of people rely on every day is where the real engineering lives. Crossing it is what Agent Engineers at Sarvam do.
The agents you build go into live operation at India's largest banks, insurers, NBFCs and government departments, and at some of the country's fastest-growing companies, handling millions of real interactions, measured against outcomes the customer wants to drive.
The hard part is not the first version. It is everything after: mapping the full space of what an agent has to handle so the scenarios that matter are covered by design rather than discovered in production, engineering for the failure modes instead of the happy path, and building the evals and instrumentation that make quality measurable, so drift surfaces in the data rather than in a customer escalation.
We treat agents as code. Not prompts someone tweaks in a console, but engineered artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and held to a regression suite, where you can reason about what a change will do and roll it back if you are wrong. Anyone who has watched an AI system quietly decay because nobody could tell which change broke it understands why this matters.
And then doing it again for the next customer, faster, because you built the first one to be repeatable.
ABOUT SARVAM
Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.
WHAT THIS ROLE PROMISES YOU
Production, at real scale
Not prototypes, not demos. Systems in live operation at some of India's largest institutions, carrying real volume, measured against outcomes the customer has signed up to. You will see the consequences of your engineering decisions within days.
You work at the source
Sarvam builds the whole stack: the foundational models, the infrastructure they run on, and the products on top of them. When a deployment needs something that does not exist yet, whether that is model behaviour, an infrastructure capability or a product change, you are not filing a ticket with a vendor and waiting on a roadmap. You are in a room with the people who built it. Anyone who has delivered AI on top of someone else's black box knows how much difference that makes.
A genuinely broad surface
Sarvam's products span conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent document processing, and content, including dubbing and document translation. You will own a motion and go deep in it, and the depth you build travels well as products mature and new ones ship.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
 - Build production agents on the Sarvam stack: prompts, system design, workflows, tool integrations, and evals.
 - Map the space the agent has to cover. Work out the scenarios that matter, how each should be handled, and where the edges are, so coverage is designed rather than discovered later.
 - Build the proof of concept when a customer wants to see it work before committing at scale, and get to a convincing result fast.
 - Integrate into systems that were never designed for this: core banking, CRM, ticketing, telephony, and whatever else the customer runs.
 - Own quality end to end. Define what good means for the use case, build the evals that measure it, and close the gap until the numbers hold.
 - Engineer agents like software. Version them, review them, and hold them to a regression suite, so quality does not depend on who last edited a prompt.
 - Tune for the constraints that decide whether a system survives production: accuracy, cost, reliability, and performance under real load.
 - Design for scale and consistency from the outset. Systems that behave the same on the hundred-thousandth interaction as the first, and that are instrumented well enough for anyone to see when they are not.
 - Take a proven pattern into a new customer and make it fit their environment, at pace and at quality.
 - At senior levels, own the technical build playbooks and the technical quality bar for a motion, and bring partner engineers up to it.
WHO YOU ARE
We are hiring across levels, from 3+ years of experience. What matters more than years is whether you have built something real users depended on and kept it working.
 - You have shipped to production and owned it afterwards. Not just built it. Kept it running, fixed it at 11pm, and let real usage change your assumptions.
 - You have worked with LLMs and agents seriously. Context engineering, tool use, structured outputs, memory, and the failure modes that only show up at scale. You have used agentic frameworks and both open and closed source models.
 - You bring engineering discipline to AI. You think in versions, tests, regressions and reproducibility. You are uncomfortable when a system's behaviour depends on a prompt nobody can account for.
 - You take evals seriously. You can define metrics that matter for a use case, build the pipeline, and tell the difference between a real signal and noise.
 - Strong Python and range across the stack. Backend services, data pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure. When you meet an unfamiliar stack you pick it up in hours.
 - You design for the long run. You build systems that hold their behaviour over months, not just on launch day: predictable under real load, instrumented so problems are visible, and structured so someone else can reason about them.
 - You can sit with a customer's engineering team. Understand their constraints, explain yours, and get to a workable answer without either side losing patience.

 An overview of this role 
 As Senior Manager, Total Rewards Operations, India, you'll lead a small team supporting GitLab's global benefits and compensation operations. You'll translate global program priorities into dependable execution, strengthen operational controls, and make processes easier to run and support across regions and time zones. You'll set clear priorities and quality standards while coaching your team to deliver accurate work. You'll support global programs in partnership with their functional owners, rather than set enterprise-wide compensation or benefits strategy.
 What You’ll Do  
 Oversee, coach, and develop the day-to-day responsibilities for the local Benefits Analyst and Senior Total Rewards Operations Analyst, establishing clear ownership, goals, feedback practices, and coverage plans.

 Partner with global program owners to coordinate execution across geographies, communicate local considerations, and support consistent team member experiences through clear written updates, decision records, and reusable documentation.
 Work with People Technology and system stakeholders to clarify requirements, test process and system changes, and improve data quality and workflow efficiency, using artificial intelligence tools responsibly where appropriate.
 What You’ll Bring  
 Experience in Total Rewards, benefits, compensation operations, or a closely related People function in a global organization, with working knowledge of benefits administration and/or compensation processes and their dependencies.
 Demonstrated people-management ability, including setting priorities, coaching team members, and developing operational capability.
 A record of delivering accurate work across multiple deadlines, stakeholders, and time zones, supported by practical controls, root-cause analysis, and process improvements.
 Clear written communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain processes and escalate risks.

title: Assurance Engineering Platform Developer SMTS / LMTS
desc:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 Job Category 
Software Engineering 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 The Experience 
We are seeking a lead full stack engineer with enterprise software engineering experience to drive the architecture, technical roadmap, and execution for our next-generation Security Assurance Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform. In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform’s core engines—including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules.
Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. You will also pioneer the team’s operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization.
 What You'll Actually Be Doing 
 End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle. 
 Architecture & System Design: Architect resilient, cloud-native microservice architectures that process large-scale compliance telemetry, support automated evidence ingestion, and execute low-latency risk evaluation engines. 
 Roadmap & Project Planning: Partner with Product Management, Security Architects, and GRC leaders to translate broad business and regulatory strategies into detailed technical roadmaps, milestones, and sprint backlogs. 
 Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org. 
 Policy & Governance as Code: Design and implement extensible Policy as Code and Compliance as Code engines (e.g., leveraging Open Policy Agent/OPA or custom evaluation frameworks) and runtime platforms (e.g. CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules. 
 Automated Evidence Collection: Lead the design of automated evidence collection pipelines integrating with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers, enterprise security tools, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and productivity / corporate applications (Workday, Netsuite, etc). 
 Risk & Regulatory Modeling: Build dynamic risk analysis engines and auditing interfaces capable of mapping continuous technical evidence against major regulatory standards (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2). 
 AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption and integration of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI APIs) across the engineering lifecycle to optimize team productivity, automate test generation, and streamline refactoring. 
 Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 Lead cross-functional alignment and technical discussions across a geographically dispersed team operating in an asynchronous-first culture. 
 You're Our Person If... 
 Experience: 6–13 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, including 3+ years at the Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) or Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) level leading technical projects and distributed engineering teams. 
 Project Ownership Track Record: Proven experience taking complex SaaS platforms or enterprise software projects from architectural inception to production delivery. 
 Strategic Execution: Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous business requirements into high-level architecture designs, concrete technical epics, and actionable execution plans. 
 Systems Engineering: Deep mastery of both Python and Java, including enterprise frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django, Flask, Spring Boot) and microservices design patterns. 
 Front-End Architecture: Advanced proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular), with experience designing scalable component libraries and complex data visualization dashboards. 
 AI Tooling & Innovation: Advanced proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery, paired with a strategic vision for integrating AI into technical workflows. 
 Data & Cloud Systems: Strong expertise in relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL/graph databases, distributed data processing, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 Regulatory Frameworks: Working knowledge of regulatory standards including NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria). 
 Compliance Engineering: Direct experience building or architecting systems around continuous control monitoring, automated audit trails, or policy engine evaluation (e.g., OPA/Rego). 
 Even Better If... 
 Prior experience architecting commercial GRC

title: Machine Learning Engineer 3
desc:
About the Role 
 Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide.
 In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You will manage the entire model lifecycle: raw behavioral data and feature engineering, architecture development, large-scale GPU training, deployment, and monitoring.
 The team is actively building in-house behavioral foundation models that learn identity-preserving representations from long sequences of user activity. This is a role for an engineer who wants to own deep learning systems end-to-end — not consume pre-built ones.
 Key Responsibilities Build and train deep learning models from scratch, including custom transformer and attention-based architectures for long behavioral event sequences.
 Own the full training stack: event tokenization, temporal and positional embeddings, self-supervised pretraining (e.g., masked modeling, contrastive learning), and downstream fine-tuning.
 Train large models efficiently on GPU infrastructure using mixed-precision training, gradient accumulation/checkpointing, efficient attention, and distributed strategies (DDP, FSDP, or equivalent).
 Build and optimize feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw behavioral events into high-quality model inputs.
 Translate prototypes into production ML systems — scalable, reliable, and observable — and drive inference performance through architectural and serving-side optimization.
 Contribute to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams; mentor junior engineers on experimentation rigor, deployment process, and responsible AI.
 Stay current with advances in ML/AI and bring relevant innovations into Adobe's products.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field.
 5+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions at scale.
 Strong programming expertise in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
 Deep understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle—from data collection to deployment and monitoring.
 Strong grasp of model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration.

title: Product Manager, Model APIs
desc:
ABOUT SARVAM
Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a Product Manager for Model APIs. This is the person who owns how developers and enterprises consume Sarvam's models, and who carries what they learn back into what we train next.
You will sit at the seam between research and the market. On one side, you own the API surface: what we ship, how it is shaped, how it is priced and packaged, and whether it holds up in production. On the other, you help set model direction: which capabilities to prioritize, which languages and domains to invest in, what “good enough to ship” means, and where the next release should aim. This is a role for someone who wants to influence the model roadmap itself, not just wrap it in an interface.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
 - Own the product surface for Sarvam's model APIs across speech, language, and multimodal, from spec and versioning to documentation, developer experience, and deprecation.
 - Shape model roadmaps alongside research leads, bringing evidence from usage, evals, and customer signal into decisions about what gets trained, fine-tuned, and released.
 - Define what quality means for each model line and hold the bar: accuracy, latency, cost per call, robustness, and the failure modes that matter to real deployments.
 - Own evaluation as a product, including benchmark suites, offline and online tests, human evals, and the reporting that makes model progress legible to everyone from researchers to customers.
 - Turn customer and developer feedback into concrete model and API requirements, and close the loop by telling them what changed and why.
 - Partner with infra and platform teams on rollout, capacity, monitoring, and reliability for models in production.
 - Drive release planning end to end: positioning, launch, migration paths for existing users, and the trade-off calls that come with each.
 - Communicate priorities and trade-offs clearly across research, engineering, GTM, and leadership.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 - 3+ years building AI/ML products, developer platforms, or APIs, ideally where the underlying model was part of the product decision rather than a fixed input.
 - Working fluency with the model lifecycle: data, training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. You do not need to train models, but you should be able to hold your own in a conversation with the people who do.
 - Strong analytical instincts and genuine comfort with data. You reach for the numbers before the narrative.
 - Sound judgment on trade-offs between quality, latency, and cost, and the confidence to make a call and defend it.
 - Ability to work closely with researchers and earn their trust.
BONUS POINTS
 - Experience with speech (ASR, TTS) or LLM APIs, and the metrics that govern them: WER, CER, MOS, TTFT, tokens per second.
 - Track record shipping and maintaining a public or enterprise-facing API.
 - Hands-on with SQL, Python, or ML tooling, enough to run your own analysis.
 - Exposure to Indian language AI, multilingual systems, or evaluation for low-resource languages.
WHY SARVAM?
Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.
 - Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
 - High ownership and high impact, from day one
 - Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
 - You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates
If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

 NVIDIA is looking for a Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our team in India. You will operate as an Incident Commander during critical events, set the technical direction for reliability engineering across multiple teams, and build the automation, observability, and AI-assisted tooling that reduce operational toil and raise reliability over time.  Lead major incidents end to end — driving triage, cross-team coordination, decision making, and executive communication across global time zones. 
 Set technical direction for SRE initiatives that improve reliability, scalability, and developer efficiency across NVIDIA's enterprise systems, and drive them to adoption beyond your immediate team. 
 Design, build, and operate distributed systems — including Kubernetes-based and cloud-native infrastructure — that power NVIDIA's AI-powered enterprise products and services. 
 Build automation for incident detection, triage, communication, and remediation, replacing manual runbooks with self-healing systems. 
 Improve observability and signal quality to enable earlier detection, reduce alert noise, and eliminate reliance on user-reported issues. 
 Drive root cause analysis and translate learnings into systemic fixes, automation, and prevention mechanisms; raise the bar on post-incident review quality across the org. 
 Apply AI and data-driven techniques — LLMs, anomaly detection, signal correlation — to enhance incident triage, summarisation, and decision support. 
 Champion AI-assisted engineering practices, including coding agents and LLM-powered tooling, to accelerate day-to-day engineering workflows. 
 Partner with Cloud, Platform, Security, and AI/ML teams to embed SRE best practices, define SLOs and error budgets, and influence architecture early in the design cycle. 
 Mentor engineers, raise engineering standards through design and code review, and help build a strong reliability culture in the India organisation. 
 What We Need To See: 
 10+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Incident Management roles, with a track record of technical leadership at scale. 
 BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 Proven experience acting as an Incident Commander or leading major incident response in complex, high-availability environments. 
 Deep understanding of distributed systems, monitoring, and reliability engineering principles — SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, and graceful degradation. 
 Strong proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Java ) to build production-grade automation and tooling. 
 Hands-on expertise with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 Solid experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (e.g., Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 Strong Linux/Unix and networking fundamentals, plus expertise in observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 Working knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) — SQL, indexing, and query optimisation. 
 Experience or familiarity with AI/ML concepts (e.g., LLMs, anomaly detection, or data-driven operations) applied to operational workflows. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief executives during high-pressure incidents and influence senior technical stakeholders. 
 Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd: 
 Building & applying AI to operations: Hands-on experience building incident management or automation platforms (ChatOps, workflow orchestration, alert intelligence) and applying AI to operations — intelligent triage, RCA generation, and signal correlation — with a demonstrable track record of reducing MTTD and MTTR, backed by numbers. 
 Scaling reliability across distributed teams: Proven ability to balance real-time incident leadership with scalable, long-term reliability solutions, including scaling a follow-the-sun model and operating AI/ML training and inference infrastructure at scale across multi-region teams. 
 Ownership & community impact: A strong sense of ownership, curiosity, and initiative — turning challenges into durable engineering solutions and diving into unfamiliar systems — along with contributions to open-source infrastructure/observability projects, conference talks, or active participation in the wider SRE community.

title: Applied Science Manager , Amazon Music Catalog Quality
desc:
The Music Catalog Quality team at Amazon Music serves a key role in developing solutions to ensure and improve the quality of catalog metadata and content across the music streaming experience. We create solutions that detect, measure, and remediate quality issues in music metadata - including artist information, track attributes, versions, content tags, and provide actionable insights that enable continuous improvement of the catalog. We leverage a host of scientific and engineering technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and automated data validation pipelines.
As an Applied Science Manager on the team, you will lead a team of scientists to define and execute a transformative vision for holistic catalog quality measurement, metadata enrichment, and content integrity. Your team will own the science solutions for foundational quality detection frameworks, metadata validation and correction technologies, state-of-the-art algorithms to identify and resolve catalog anomalies (violative content, duplicative/low value content, misattributed tracks, incorrect metadata), and/or agentic AI solutions that help internal teams quickly surface and fix quality issues to ensure customers receive accurate, complete catalog experiences.
Key job responsibilities
You independently manage a team of scientists. You identify the needs of your team and effectively grow, hire, and promote scientists to maintain a high-performing team.
You have a broad understanding of scientific techniques, several of which may fall out of your specific job function.
You define the strategic vision for your team. You establish a roadmap and successfully deliver scientific solutions that innovate on catalog quality detection, metadata enrichment, and content integrity.
You define clear goals for your team and effectively prioritize, balancing short-term quality improvements and long-term innovation in catalog intelligence.
You establish clear and effective metrics and scientific process to enforce consistent, high-quality artifact delivery and measurable catalog quality improvements.
You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks. You know when to escalate.
You communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences. You author strategic documentation for your team. You communicate issues and options with leaders in such a way that facilitates understanding and that leads to a decision.
You work successfully with customers, leaders, and engineering teams. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues.
About the team
We are a team of scientists and MLEs focused on music catalog quality and metadata intelligence. You will work with colleagues with deep expertise in ML, NLP, CV, Gen AI, and data quality systems with a diverse range of backgrounds. We partner closely with top-notch engineers, product managers, content operations teams, and other scientists with expertise in music metadata, content classification, and building scalable modeling and software solutions that keep the Amazon Music catalog accurate, complete, and trustworthy. Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- Knowledge of ML, NLP, Information Retrieval and Analytics
- 6+ years of applied research experience
- Knowledge of machine learning approaches and algorithms
- 3+ years of programming in Java, C++, Python or related language experience Preferred qualifications: - Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers
- 5+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

 Partner closely with Support Engineering team members through pairing sessions and stable counterpart relationships to share knowledge and solve problems together.

 Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution.
 Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations.
 Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools.
 Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers.

You will use advances in generative AI, large language models, and modern data technologies to make analytics more accessible, personalized, and actionable for customers worldwide.
This is a highly visible role that requires strong customer obsession, technical judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence and deliver across multiple engineering and business organizations. You will also build products that help customers analyze organizational spending, identify savings opportunities, and improve procurement outcomes.  As an Engineering Manager on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll build and lead a team of engineers in Bangalore who own how users, applications, tokens, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents sign in to GitLab. At GitLab, we see our team as our product.  Give clear, regular feedback, run career conversations, and handle performance issues early.

 What you'll bring 
 Significant experience as an engineering manager of backend or platform teams, including hiring and growing senior engineers.

title: Engineering Manager, Tech Foundations
desc:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 The Community You Will Join: 
 The CRM Engineering team builds the go-to-market platforms and tooling that Airbnb uses to grow and manage its supply. We power the full host lifecycle: acquiring new hosts, onboarding them, and retaining and growing them once they are live. We also build the platforms that connect Airbnb with its wider community, including Hosts, Guests, Local Community Leaders, Government Regulators, and more. We partner with business teams across Homes, Hotels, Services, Experiences, Luxe, API partners, and Co-hosts, as well as Policy, Community, Airbnb.org, and Escalations. Here are a few examples of what we build:
 - GTM Platform and Tooling: A unified funnel platform with a canonical source of truth for leads, plus the workflows and operations tooling that help sales teams and market managers grow and manage supply at scale across every business unit.
 - Digital Channel Platform: Lets us engage hosts and prospective hosts on the channels they prefer in more than 200 geographies, such as WhatsApp in Brazil and India and LINE in Japan. It is built to scale from one-to-one outreach to large, personalized engagement, and it is critical to supply growth.
 - Account Management and Retention: Tools, notifications, and insights that help account managers support and grow high-value hosts.
 - Community Platform: A social platform of Host Clubs, a peer-to-peer Community Center, and Events, driving community enablement, collaboration, and success for hosts around the world.
 - Policy Cloud: Enables Airbnb to engage with regulatory bodies across the globe regarding short-term rental regulations. This platform is the source of truth for the regulations that impact our business and provides intelligence, including AI-generated summaries, to address unique business challenges.
 The Difference You Will Make: 
 As an Engineering Manager, you'll be leading a team of very senior, highly motivated, high achieving engineers within the Community platform and Policy platform teams. You will work closely with product managers, designers and other engineering leaders to plan and deliver a wide range of new and improved features and capabilities powering Airbnb messaging. You'll be finding opportunities to shape ambitious technical and product visions and turn them into a polished reality.
 A Typical Day: 
 - Work with product, design and other stakeholders to define, prioritize and execute roadmap
 - Work with engineers to plan, sequence, make tradeoffs and deliver new features and platform capabilities
 - Understand the state of our systems to determine where investment may be needed to maintain system health and build for long-term success
 - Nurture a culture of engineering excellence
 - Hire and coach exceptional engineering talent, spending  understand underlying motivations and dynamics
 Your Expertise: 
 3-5+ years of hands-on experience managing an engineering team and 9+ years of relevant software development industry experience in a fast paced tech environment
 Strong expertise in building large-scale backend systems and experience in user facing features
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 Proven experience working with many engineering teams and cross functional partners.
 Flexible in leadership style, can adapt to a variety of ways of working depends on the situation
 Experience leading and shipping large initiatives with high business impact
 Creating a strong culture of operational excellence with focus on raising the bar for quality, reliability and availability
 Good judgment in making tradeoffs to balance short-term business needs with long-term technical quality
 Strong communication skill and ability to influence decisions from a wide variety of stakeholders
 Experience fostering an inclusive and engaging team environment

 Passionate about building AI-driven applications that deliver innovative and impactful solutions

title: Director of Engineering (Data Infrastructure)

You'll establish foundational teams in Bengaluru owning the bedrock systems that guarantee billing correctness, operational resilience, and zero-downtime recovery across our entire monetization stack, alongside multi-region data ingestion, developer platforms, and deployment automation that eliminate friction at petabyte scale. title: Technical Partner Enablement Manager
desc:
Sarvam Circle, our partner ecosystem, is one of our fastest growing vectors. It brings in firms to take frontier AI to government and public institutions, enterprises, and MSMEs across the country. Certified partner engineers building on our stack extend that reach at a breadth and pace that compounds. Every firm that gets good at building on Sarvam widens what all of our work reaches.
There is a version of partner-built AI that actually works. Where a partner's engineers hold the same bar our own engineers do, where the playbooks are good enough to travel, and where a customer gets the same system whoever is in the room. That bar exists because Sarvam's engineers set it. Carrying it outward intact is what this role does, and it is the part most companies never solve.
This is a hands-on technical role, not a pre-sales one. You own the engineering core of Sarvam Circle: how partner engineers get certified on our stack, what standard their work is held to, whether they can run an engagement without a Sarvam engineer beside them, and whether what they ship holds up.
Done well, a large share of everything Sarvam delivers runs through the capability you built.
ABOUT SARVAM
Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.
WHAT THIS ROLE PROMISES YOU
You shape the engine, not just run it
Sarvam Circle already has the firms and the momentum. Training and enablement is central to how Sarvam works with its partners, and how that actually operates is being designed now: the certification, the quality bar, the onboarding, the scorecards, the standard a partner engineer is held to. You are early enough to own its shape, at a company growing this fast.
Leverage over headcount
Your output is not what you deliver, it is what several hundred engineers across multiple firms are capable of delivering. The ceiling on your impact is set by how well you build the system.
You work at the source
Sarvam builds the whole stack: the foundational models, the infrastructure they run on, and the products on top. When a partner hits something the platform does not do yet, you are in a room with the people who built it.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
 - Own the technical relationship with a set of partner firms: what their engineers can build, how much certified capacity they hold, and the quality of what they ship.
 - Build the certification programme. Define what a partner engineer must demonstrate before they touch a Sarvam deployment, and run the process that gets them there.
 - Own partner enablement: the playbooks, tooling, training and access partner teams need to build on the Sarvam stack without a Sarvam engineer beside them. Our engineers author the technical build playbooks; you own whether they exist, are current, and are legible enough for someone outside Sarvam to execute.
 - Translate Sarvam's platform, models and product surface into something a partner's engineering team can build with. Most of the leverage in this role is in how well you do this.
 - Shape how a partner gets used on an engagement: which firm fits the work, where in the engagement they come in, and how the build splits between their engineers and ours.
 - Lead the first co-delivered engagement with a new partner, hands-on, and own the readiness call on whether they can run the next one independently.
 - Own the review cadence with partners. It is what keeps us close to the work: where each engagement stands against plan, where the risk sits, and what has to change before a date slips.
 - Hold the quality bar across the partner base: scorecards, an honest read on whether partner-built work matches our own standard, and corrective plans when it does not.
WHO YOU ARE
We are hiring across levels, from 6+ years of experience, up to Lead.
 - You have worked with systems integrators or consulting firms, from the inside or across the table. You know how their engineering organisations actually work, how their engineers are staffed and incentivised, and where quality tends to slip.
 - You are technical, and partners respect that. You do not need to ship production code, but you should be able to review an implementation, spot where it will break, and hold a design conversation with a partner's engineering lead as a peer.
 - You have built capability at scale. Enablement programmes, certification, training, or technical onboarding. Something that made other people better at building, that outlasted your involvement.
 - You understand agentic AI and can teach it. LLMs and agents in production, why evals matter, and what breaks at scale. You can take an engineer who has never built an agent and get them to competence.
 - You hold a line under pressure. When a programme is behind and the easy answer is to let a standard slide, you are the person who does not.
 - You are comfortable building from zero. No template, no precedent. You would rather design it than wait for it.
Sarvam is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of background, identity, or personal characteristics. We believe the best AI for India can only be built by a team that reflects India.

title: SAP Functional SME
desc:
GAQ226R76
 About Databricks 
 At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business.
 We're looking for an SAP Functional SME to own the functional design of our core finance processes on S/4HANA and to shape how AI and agentic automation reimagine them. In this role,  you'll be the deep functional authority for your domain—translating how the business actually runs into standard, clean-core S/4HANA solutions, using process intelligence to find what's broken, and defining where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process . You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI, bridging Finance and Engineering to deliver a simpler, smarter, more automated experience.
 The Opportunity 
 SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As the SAP Functional SME, you'll own the functional blueprint for those processes—leading discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design, configuring S/4HANA, and defining the requirements for the intelligent, agentic layer that automates routine work and guides users through exceptions and approvals. You'll use process mining and business process intelligence to quantify opportunity and prioritize what to build, and you'll make the call on where AI-driven recommendations belong versus deterministic rules. Your mission is to combine deep functional expertise with the power of Databricks AI to create a modern, highly automated finance experience that lets the business scale.
 What You'll Do 
 Own Functional Design: Lead end-to-end process discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design for major finance processes (Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash), define S/4HANA solution scope, and design to standard, clean-core capabilities wherever possible.
 Configure S/4HANA: Own functional configuration, business rules, and master-data strategy for your domain, and partner with developers on extensions, APIs, and orchestration where standard functionality falls short.
 Drive Process Intelligence: Use process mining and business process intelligence (leveraging SAP Process Intelligence and related tools) to identify root causes, quantify opportunity, and prioritize improvements; translate those findings into concrete S/4HANA requirements.
 Shape the AI & Agentic Layer: Define the requirements for AI-assisted and agentic process improvements—task automation, intelligent recommendations, anomaly detection, and generative assistants—and make clear judgments about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process, where human-in-the-loop is required, and where a deterministic rule is the better answer.
 Bridge Business and Engineering: Serve as the connective tissue between Finance process owners and the engineering pods, partnering with architects and developers to embed AI safely and to define the data flows between S/4HANA, process intelligence tools, SAP BTP, and Databricks AI.
 Run Workshops and Validate Value: Facilitate stakeholder workshops to validate business value, define acceptance criteria, and lead user acceptance testing for both functional and AI features.
 Measure Outcomes: Define KPIs and track ROI for process improvements—cycle time, touchless transaction rate, exception and manual-touch reduction, adoption—and build the business cases for prioritized automation and AI initiatives.
 Enable Adoption: Coach and upskill process owners and functional teams on process intelligence, best practices, and AI adoption, and drive readiness and change management for what you ship.
 What You Bring 
 6+ years of SAP functional consulting experience , with hands-on delivery across at least one full S/4HANA lifecycle and deep expertise in one or more finance domains—Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, or Order-to-Cash—plus working fluency in adjacent areas and in master-data governance.
 Process Intelligence: Demonstrated experience leading process discovery, process mapping, and process mining using SAP Process Intelligence or equivalent BPI tools, and translating mining outputs into solution requirements.
 Clean-Core Mindset: Strong bias toward standard, clean-core S/4HANA design, with sound judgment about when a requirement genuinely warrants an extension versus a change in process.
 AI & Agentic Automation: Practical experience applying Databricks AI and agentic capabilities to enterprise processes, with strong judgment on where AI can drive automation and decision support while maintaining appropriate governance, controls, auditability, and human oversight.
 Integration Awareness: Solid understanding of integration patterns (APIs/OData, IDoc, SAP Integration Suite / BTP) and the data requirements that feed process mining and AI models.
 Governance Rigor: Working knowledge of SAP authorizations, SoD, SOX and audit requirements, and the ability to design processes and automation that satisfy them.
 Stakeholder Leadership: Excellent workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and change-management skills, and the ability to present executive-level ROI and translate technical capability into measurable business value.
 Business-First Mindset: Pragmatic, outcome-driven approach to reducing process waste and risk, and comfort leading through ambiguity across complex business and IT landscapes.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 SAP S/4HANA Associate or Professional
