desc:
About the Team 
 The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.
 You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
 Role Description 
 As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
 You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
 This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
 The impact you will have 
 C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
 End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
 Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
 Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
 Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.
 What we look for 
 Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
 Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
 Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
 Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
 Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
desc:
Job Details: 
 Job Description:  The Role and Impact: 
Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms.
 Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use.
 In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters.
 This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it.
 Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software.
 If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection.
 About the Team: 
The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms.
 We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams.
 Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy.
 The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 ·   Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack.
 ·   Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture.
 ·   Design and develop hardware-aware and hardware-agnostic optimizations for AI frameworks and runtimes.
 ·   Optimize LLM inference techniques including KV-cache management, attention, continuous batching, and quantization.
 ·   Work hands-on with serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or equivalent technologies.
 ·   Analyze host and accelerator performance using tools such as VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, and roofline modeling.
 ·   Debug complex performance issues spanning Python frameworks, native code, Linux, runtime libraries, and hardware.
 ·   Convert performance findings into software changes, upstream contributions, BKCs, and reusable optimization guidance.
 ·   Collaborate with open-source communities to upstream and integrate performance improvements.
 Translate silicon-level findings into actionable recommendations for framework developers, while bringing application and framework insights back to Intel platform and silicon teams.
 Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications: 
 ·   BE +10 years / M.Tech +8 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
 ·   Significant hands-on experience in performance engineering, systems optimization, or workload characterization on server-class platforms.
 ·   Demonstrated ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements.
 ·   Strong programming skills in Python and C++, or equivalent systems programming experience in C/Rust.
 ·   Strong understanding of server architecture including cache hierarchy, memory bandwidth, NUMA, interconnects, and system-level performance behavior.
 ·   Hands-on experience with Linux performance and system technologies such as affinity, huge pages, cgroups, eBPF, ftrace, perf, or equivalent tools.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 ·   Deep understanding of LLM inference, including KV-cache, paged attention, continuous batching and quantization such as INT8, INT4, or FP8.
 ·   Hands-on experience modifying or optimizing AI serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, TGI, OpenVINO, or equivalent.
 ·   Experience building, profiling, or optimizing Agentic AI systems using technologies such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP-based frameworks, or similar platforms.
 ·   Experience with hardware counter-level performance analysis using VTune, EMON/PMU, perf, top-down analysis, or roofline modeling.
 ·   Contributions to significant open-source projects, including upstream code contributions.
 ·   Ability to communicate across abstraction layers, translating silicon-level findings for software developers and application-level requirements for hardware architects.
 Why Join This Team? 
 This role gives you the opportunity to work across boundaries that few engineering positions span:
 Agentic AI & LLMs → AI frameworks → inference runtimes Linux → server architecture → silicon 
 You won't be limited to measuring performance or optimizing an isolated component. You'll help connect the entire stack, identify where the real bottlenecks are, implement improvements, and make those optimizations available to developers and customers.
 The result is tangible: better AI performance today, stronger software solutions for customers, and insights that can influence tomorrow's Intel platforms.

title: Principal DFT Engineer
desc:
About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .
 Job Description: Principal Digital DFT Engineer 
 Role Summary 
 The Principal Digital DFT Engineer is responsible for architecting, implementing, and verifying advanced DFT solutions for complex digital ASICs and SoCs. This position emphasizes direct technical execution, deep problem-solving, and ownership of DFT flows for robust testability and manufacturing yield.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own and drive all aspects of DFT architecture, definition, and implementation for digital chips, including scan insertion, ATPG, boundary scan, MBIST, logic BIST, JTAG and test compression techniques.
 Hands-on execution with EDA tools for scan synthesis, test pattern generation, fault simulation, and DFT rule checks.
 Create and validate test plans targeting high coverage for stuck-at, transition, and critical path faults.
 Integrate DFT with RTL and physical design teams; resolve complex trade-offs impacting fault coverage, PPA, or manufacturability.
 Optimize test modes, design for manufacturability, and debug silicon failures from bring-up through production ramp.
 Develop and implement low-overhead test structures and warranty schemes for new and legacy IP.
 Directly debug, analyze, and resolve DFT-related issues in simulation, emulation, and in the lab using standard test equipment.
 Deliver documented DFT architectures, test strategies, implementation scripts (TCL/Python/Perl), and design guidelines for engineering teams.
 Collaborate with ATE test engineers to implement production test solutions, reduce test costs, and improve coverage.
 Mentor engineers in DFT methodology, best practices, tool usage, and industry standards.
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics/VLSI Engineering or equivalent.
 10+ years’ proven hands-on experience in DFT for digital ASIC/SoC development, with multiple tapeouts for large designs.
 Expert skills in DFT flows: scan, ATPG, MBIST, BIST, JTAG, boundary scan, fault simulation.
 Strong command of EDA tools: Synopsys DFT Compiler, Tessent, Cadence Modus, or equivalent.
 Scripting abilities (TCL, Python, Perl) for DFT automation and reporting.
 Solid knowledge of RTL design, synthesis, timing, and SoC architecture constraints.
 Demonstrated ability to debug complex DFT and test-mode issues at lab and production level.
 Ability to create technical documentation, guides, and mentor junior engineers.
 Nice-to-Have Skills 
 Experience with DFT for advanced nodes (≤ 7nm), 2.5D/3D packaging, or high-speed IP.
 Production ATE pattern development and test data evaluation.
 Knowledge of safety (ISO 26262) or security-oriented DFT requirements.
 DFT for memory BIST (SRAM/DRAM), and custom macro testing.

This means building and operating data platforms that handle terabyte-scale persistent data stores and sustained large daily ingestion volumes across structured records, documents, imagery, audio, and geospatial data. You will design and maintain the databases, object stores, ingestion pipelines, and processing layers that make this possible.
You will make critical decisions about storage architecture, indexing strategies, pipeline orchestration, and system performance — often in constrained, air-gapped, or operationally sensitive environments where you cannot rely on managed cloud services or standard enterprise tooling. You will own the reliability and performance of the infrastructure layer in your assigned accounts.
What You'll Do
• Design and operate data storage architectures (relational, document, vector, object storage) capable of managing terabyte-scale datasets across multiple modalities
• Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that reliably process daily data influx — including batch and streaming workloads — with monitoring, error handling, and backpressure management
• Implement indexing, partitioning, and query optimisation strategies that allow AI systems and data scientists to retrieve and reason over large datasets with acceptable latency
• Work with Embedded Data Scientists to translate ontologies, schemas, and semantic structures into performant physical data models and storage configurations
• Deploy and manage database systems, vector stores, and search infrastructure in air-gapped, on-premise, or security-constrained environments
• Build observability into the data platform: monitor pipeline health, storage utilisation, query performance, and ingestion lag
• Own capacity planning and scaling decisions for data infrastructure across assigned client deployments
• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to feed infrastructure learnings back into the core platform and tooling
What We're Looking For
• 4–8 years in data infrastructure, data engineering, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering, ideally at organisations operating at significant data scale
• Direct experience managing multi-terabyte data stores — you have personally built or operated systems handling 10TB+ of persistent data and sustained high-throughput ingestion
• Deep working knowledge of at least two of: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, or comparable systems — including tuning, indexing, partitioning, and operational management
• Experience building production data ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Airflow, Flink, dbt, or equivalent frameworks
• Strong proficiency in Python and/or Go, with experience writing production infrastructure tooling and automation
• Solid understanding of storage systems and formats: object storage (S3/MinIO), columnar formats (Parquet, ORC), and how to choose the right storage layer for the workload
• Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) in production settings
• Experience with infrastructure-as-code and deployment automation (Terraform or similar)
Bonus Points
• Experience with vector databases or embedding stores (Milvus, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, or similar)
• Experience deploying and operating infrastructure in air-gapped, on-premise, or hybrid environments
Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not
people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and
you believe you can do this work; we want to hear from you.
Why Sarvam?
Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.
• Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: LMTS - Lead AI/ML Engineer (LLM Post-Training)
desc:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 Job Category 
Software Engineering 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters
 Salesforce has immediate opportunities for engineers who want their work to shape how trusted enterprise AI is trained, evaluated, and delivered. You will work with a group of world-class engineers to train and post-train open-weight language models for demanding enterprise workflows.
 This is a model-training role, not a wrapper around a hosted LLM and not a prompt-engineering-only role. You will own the complete post-training loop: data generation, supervised fine-tuning, preference or reinforcement learning when appropriate, rigorous evaluation, and production serving. You will materially improve the behavior of models, not merely integrate model APIs.
 The role encompasses ML research engineering, data generation, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference systems, and technical leadership. You will own code, experiments, evaluation evidence, and production behavior. We value demonstrated engineering judgment and reproducible results over credentials, paper claims, or an extensive keyword list.
 We pride ourselves on building high-quality, maintainable systems that make the model more capable without compromising trust, safety, or operability. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions empower our people, products, company, and customers to thrive.
 Core Responsibilities & Scope 
 Train, adapt, and serve capable, reliable open-weight language models for enterprise workflows. 
 Own fine-tuning experiments from baseline through release: choose training objectives, run SFT and LoRA/QLoRA recipes, compare checkpoints against rigorous held-out evaluation, and diagnose failures before the next run. 
 Generate high-quality domain training data at scale, including synthetic instruction data, multi-turn conversations, reasoning and tool-use trajectories, structured outputs, counterexamples, preference pairs, and difficult evaluation cases. 
 Build the data engine behind post-training: source-grounded authoring, quality filtering, deduplication, contamination controls, dataset versioning, train/validation/test splits, packing, tokenization, and loss masking. 
 Design and run post-training experiments beyond SFT when justified, including DPO, ORPO, GRPO, RLVR, distillation, and other preference or reinforcement-learning methods. Match the method to a measured capability problem and a defensible reward signal. 
 Design and operate model-quality evaluation: held-out task suites, model-based and human review, tool-use and structured-output accuracy, multi-turn reliability, safety regressions, ablations, and error analysis. 
 Investigate model behavior deeply: identify whether a failure comes from data quality, training objective, model capacity, decoding, context handling, tool interface, or serving behavior, then produce evidence for the corrective action. 
 Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow. 
 Build reliable model-serving and inference capabilities, balancing quality, latency, throughput, memory use, and operational reliability. 
 Build robust integrations between models, tools, and enterprise systems, including structured outputs, function calling, and multi-step agent behavior. 
 Make architecture and design decisions with strong attention to model quality, reproducibility, performance, security, scalability, and future extensibility. 
 Improve observability, traceability, failure analysis, test coverage, and developer workflows across the training and serving lifecycle. 
 Work with domain experts to turn real workflows, product behavior, APIs, and failure cases into independently verifiable training and evaluation material. 
 Protect customer and company data: use approved sources only, preserve provenance, and keep credentials and sensitive data out of training and model prompts unless specifically authorized. 
 Review model, data, and application changes for factual correctness, quality, security, performance, and operational risk. 
 Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that raises the quality bar across the team.
 Minimum Requirements 
 10+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on production systems. 
 Strong Python engineering experience building and maintaining reliable production systems. 
 Hands-on ownership of LLM post-training. You have trained or materially improved open-weight language models through SFT and LoRA/QLoRA. Experience with preference optimization, RL, distillation, or continued pre-training is strongly valued. API integration alone does not qualify. 
 Hands-on ownership of training-data generation and curation. You have produced, filtered, reviewed, and versioned task-specific datasets, including synthetic instruction data, conversations, reasoning traces, tool calls, preference data, or structured outputs. 
 Strong practical understanding of the post-training stack: chat templates, tokenizer

title: Sr Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - S&T
desc:
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.
AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. 
Key job responsibilities
As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management. 
About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner. - Knowledge of cloud architecture
- 10+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience Preferred qualifications: - Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
- Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
- 7+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Professional level certification
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- 10+ years' experience in designing and implementing large distributed systems, with deep expertise in core infrastructure, solution architecture, and distributed computing patterns.

title: Senior Architect, GPU and SoC Modelling
desc:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
 The NVIDIA Architecture Modelling group is looking for architects and software developers to join our various architecture efforts. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is to innovate in the graphics and parallel computing fields, delivering the highest performance in the world for high-performance computing. We are constantly looking for ways to improve our GPU architecture and maintain our leadership. In this position, you will be working with other world-class architects on modeling, analysis and validation of chip architectures and features that advance the state of art in performance and efficiency.
 What you'll be doing: 
 Modeling and analysis of graphics and / or SOC algorithms and features
 Work in a matrixed environment, across the different modelling teams, to document, design, develop tools to analyze and simulate, validate, and verify models
 Familiarize with the different models (functional and performance) that are used at Nvidia and help with feature implementation as required.
 Develop tests, test plans, and testing infrastructure for new architectures/features.
 Code coverage analysis and reporting
 Mentor younger engineers and help sustain good coding practices.
 Learn about newer modelling techniques and frameworks, evaluate the best solution for our needs and work with your manager to drive the change
 Help develop AI based tools to increase efficiency.
 What we need to see: 
 Bachelors Degree (or equivalent experience) in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering)
 8+ years of relevant work experience or MS with 5+ years of experience or PhD with 3+ years of experience
 Strong programming ability: C++, C along with a good understanding of build systems (CMAKE, make), toolchains (GCC, MSVC) and libraries (STL, BOOST)
 Computer Architecture background with experience in modeling with SystemC & TLM preferred
 Familiarity with Docker, Jenkins, Python, Perl
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills and ability to work in a distributed team environment.
 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Do you love the challenge of crafting the highest-performance silicon GPUs and SoCs possible? If so, we want to hear from you! Come, join our Architecture Simulation and Modelling team and help build the real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field.

title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
desc:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.
Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.
Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.
ABOUT SARVAM
Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.
WHAT THIS ROLE PROMISES YOU
You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
 - Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
 - Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
 - Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
 - Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
 - Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
 - Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
 - Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
 - Write design docs and keep decisions documented.
Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.
WHO YOU ARE
We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.
 - You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
 - You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
 - You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
 - You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
 - You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
 - You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
 - You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.
BONUS POINTS
 - Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
 - Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
 - Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
 - Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
 - Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
 - On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
 - Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.
